332: And this is how it is when the Holy One, blessed be He, descends to govern the Tree of the Knowledge of Good and Evil. That is, the good is Metatron, the evil is Samael. He is a demon, king of the demons. Metatron is an angel, king of the angels. But from the angle of the Tree of Life, The Omnipotent [Shaddai] is the Foundation [Yesod]. And because of that, they are two below, the servant and its master, which are not one unit. But above, it is one, Splendor [Tiferet] and Foundation, since the body and the circumcision are considered one. For it is the middle column and the righteous one.
